mapper.sql: B.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, B.BID_PBANC_NO AS bidPbancNo, B.PBANC_NM AS pbancNm, B.PBANC_STTS_CD AS pbancSttsCd, C.CD_NM AS pbancSttsNm, B.LMT_PAGE_CNT AS lmtPageCnt, NVL(B.DMND_INST_NM, B.ORDER_INST_NM) AS instNm, B.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN AS sprvsnTeamSn, ST.TEAM_NM AS sprvsnTeamNm, (SELECT LISTAGG(PT.TEAM_NM, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY PT.TEAM_NM) FROM TB_PTCP_TEAM P JOIN TB_TEAM PT ON PT.TEAM_SN = P.TEAM_SN WHERE P.PBANC_SN = B.PBANC_SN) AS ptcpTeamNms
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_BID_PBANC B JOIN TB_PRP_TMMBR M ON M.PBANC_SN = B.PBANC_SN AND M.USER_ID = #{userId} LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD C ON C.GROUP_CD = 'PBSTS' AND C.CD = B.PBANC_STTS_CD LEFT JOIN TB_TEAM ST ON ST.TEAM_SN = B.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN ORDER BY B.PBANC_SN DESC
SELECT FROM TB_BID_PBANC B LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD C ON C.GROUP_CD = 'PBSTS' AND C.CD = B.PBANC_STTS_CD LEFT JOIN TB_TEAM ST ON ST.TEAM_SN = B.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN WHERE B.PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PRP_TMMBR WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT U.USER_ID AS userId, U.USER_NM AS userNm, U.TEAM_SN AS teamSn, T.TEAM_NM AS teamNm, M.PTCP_SE_CD AS ptcpSeCd, U.AUTHRT_CD AS authrtCd FROM TB_PRP_TMMBR M JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = M.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_TEAM T ON T.TEAM_SN = U.TEAM_SN WHERE M.PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND M.PTCP_SE_CD IN ('PT010', 'PT020') AND U.ACNT_STTS_CD <> 'AS050' ORDER BY M.PTCP_SE_CD, U.USER_NM
mapper.sql: U.USER_ID AS userId, U.USER_NM AS userNm, U.TEAM_SN AS teamSn, T.TEAM_NM AS teamNm, T.DEPT_CD AS deptCd, U.AUTHRT_CD AS authrtCd, U.ACNT_STTS_CD AS acntSttsCd
mapper.select: SELECT , J.CD_NM AS jbgdNm FROM TB_USER U JOIN TB_TEAM T ON T.TEAM_SN = U.TEAM_SN LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD J ON J.GROUP_CD = 'JBGDS' AND J.CD = U.JBGD_CD WHERE T.DEPT_CD = 'DP030' AND U.AUTHRT_CD IN ('AU030', 'AU040') AND U.ACNT_STTS_CD <> 'AS050' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_PRP_TMMBR M WHERE M.PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND M.USER_ID = U.USER_ID) AND U.TEAM_SN = #{teamSn} AND J.CD_NM = #{jbgdNm} AND U.USER_NM LIKE '%' || #{name} || '%' ORDER BY CASE WHEN U.TEAM_SN = (SELECT SPRVSN_TEAM_SN FROM TB_BID_PBANC WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn}) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, T.TEAM_NM, U.USER_NM, U.USER_ID OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT T.TEAM_SN AS teamSn, T.TEAM_NM AS teamNm FROM TB_TEAM T WHERE T.DEPT_CD = 'DP030' AND T.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY T.TEAM_NM
SELECT CD_NM FROM TB_COM_CD WHERE GROUP_CD = 'JBGDS' AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_SEQ
SELECT FROM TB_USER U LEFT JOIN TB_TEAM T ON T.TEAM_SN = U.TEAM_SN WHERE U.USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT , M.PTCP_SE_CD AS ptcpSeCd FROM TB_PRP_TMMBR M JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = M.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_TEAM T ON T.TEAM_SN = U.TEAM_SN WHERE M.PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND M.USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PRP_TMMBR (PBANC_SN, USER_ID, PTCP_SE_CD) VALUES (#{pbancSn}, #{userId}, #{ptcpSeCd})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_PRP_TMMBR WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TOC WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND PIC_ID = #{userId}

SELECT T.TEAM_SN AS teamSn, T.TEAM_NM AS teamNm, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_PTCP_TEAM P WHERE P.PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND P.TEAM_SN = T.TEAM_SN) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ptcpYn, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PRP_TMMBR M JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = M.USER_ID WHERE M.PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND M.PTCP_SE_CD = 'PT020' AND U.TEAM_SN = T.TEAM_SN) AS memberCnt FROM TB_TEAM T WHERE T.DEPT_CD = 'DP030' AND T.USE_YN = 'Y' AND T.TEAM_SN <> NVL((SELECT SPRVSN_TEAM_SN FROM TB_BID_PBANC WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn}), -1) ORDER BY T.TEAM_NM
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PTCP_TEAM WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND TEAM_SN = #{teamSn}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_PTCP_TEAM WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND TEAM_SN = #{teamSn}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BID_PBANC SET LMT_PAGE_CNT = #{lmtPageCnt} WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn}
